architecture: 6 cameras -> frozen OpenDriveFM backbone -> z(384) -> trainable projector -> 4 prefix embeddings -> frozen GPT-2 (85.4M, vocab 404) -> residual waypoint tokens
tokenisation: residual on the constant-velocity prior, 200 bins over ±10.0 m per axis
caveats: All 404 keyframes: 324 train / 80 val. Still a small corpus for a language model.

The frozen GPT-2 is the repo's own checkpoint, previously fine-tuned on 404 copies of an all-zero trajectory, so it is a weak prior. Pretrained GPT-2 could not be substituted: huggingface.co is blocked by egress policy in both environments.
Decoding is constrained so even positions emit x-bins and odd positions y-bins.
Compared against the constant-velocity prior it predicts residuals on.
